pershkrimi: Fixture 2. A REAL contract: BIOCHECK Diagnostic Center (medical laboratory), Tirana, signed 08.11.2023, indefinite term, lab technician, 100,000 leke/month. Professionally drafted and mostly compliant, which is what makes the failures realistic.
burimi: studioligjorememinaj.al, published model used by a real Tirana employer
shenim_rishikimi: Findings marked besueshmeria=siguri are verified word-for-word against the corpus. Those marked per_rishikim need Boyie's legal judgement before they go in the key for real.

klauzolat.arsyeja: Documents required on hiring. Includes 'Vertetim i gjendjes gjyqesore' (criminal record). Not regulated by the Kodi i Punes; sits under data protection and anti-discrimination law, outside this corpus.
Probation 3 months and 5 days notice. Matches Neni 142/1, 142/3, 150/1, 150/2 exactly.
klauzolat.shenim_formatimi: Source document numbers two consecutive points both as 5.2.

shkeljet.pse: Clause 7.5 bans competition 'gjate periudhes se vlefshmerise se kesaj kontrate si dhe pas perfundimit te saj' with NO duration, NO place and NO activity scope. Neni 29/1 requires all three to be stated clearly and caps the ban at one year. The contract is pa afat te caktuar, so the ban has no measurable start or end.
shkeljet.citim: Marrëveshja duhet të përcaktojë qartë ndalimin e konkurrencës për vendin, kohën, llojin e veprimtarisë, për të mos dëmtuar të ardhmen ekonomike të punëmarrësit. Afati i ndalimit nuk mund të jetë më shumë se një vit.

shkeljet.pse: No compensation is offered for the non-compete period. Neni 28/3 makes the ban enforceable only if the employer pays at least 75% of salary during it.
shkeljet.citim: Punëdhënësi mund të kërkojë zbatimin e marrëveshjes për ndalimin e konkurrencës vetëm nëse i ofron punëmarrësit, gjatë periudhës së ndalimit, jo më pak se 75 për qind të pagës që ai do të merrte po të vazhdonte të punonte për punëdhënësin.

klauzolat.arsyeja: Confidentiality and conflict of interest. Not constrained by the Kodi i Punes.

TRAP, same shape as clause 6 of fixture 1. Salary paid on the 5th of each month. Neni 116/1 requires payment at month end for monthly salaries BUT allows otherwise 'kur parashikohet ndryshe ne marreveshje me shkrim', and this contract is that written agreement. Flagging this is a false positive.
klauzolat.shenim_vkm: Whether 100,000 leke clears the minimum wage cannot be judged from the Code. Neni 111/1 defers it to a VKM.

shkeljet.pse: Clause 10.2 caps overtime at 8 hours per WEEK and states no annual cap. Neni 90/1 caps overtime at 200 hours per YEAR. Eight hours a week sustained is 416 hours, more than double the legal annual ceiling. The clause permits what the law forbids by omitting the annual limit.
shkeljet.shenim: Arguable: the clause sets a weekly ceiling rather than promising year-round overtime. Boyie to decide whether this is a finding or a note.

klauzolat.te_sakta: 40-hour week in 10.1 matches Neni 83. The 25% overtime premium in 10.2 matches Neni 91/1.
klauzolat.gabim_citimi_nga_kontrata: Clause 10.2 cites 'nenin 91' for the overtime LIMIT. Neni 91 governs overtime PAY; the limits are in Neni 90. The contract itself mis-cites. Not a legal violation, but worth reporting to the client.

shkeljet.pse: Clause 11.3 compensates work on the weekly rest day or on official holidays with 'jo me pak se 25 per qind shtese'. Neni 91/3 requires AT LEAST 50 per cent for exactly those two situations. The only exception is a kontrate kolektive, and this is an individual contract. The employee is underpaid by half for every holiday worked.
shkeljet.citim: Orët shtesë të punës të kryera gjatë pushimit javor ose në ditët e festave zyrtare kompensohen me pushim ose pagë të paktën 50 për qind më të madhe se orët shtesë të bëra ose paga normale, me përjashtim të rasteve kur parashikohet ndryshe në kontratën kolektive.

rast_date_efektive.teksti_kontrates: Kohezgjatja e pushimeve vjetore eshte jo më pak se 4 javë kalendarike ne vit.
rast_date_efektive.teksti_sot: Neni 92/2: jo më pak se 22 ditë pune
rast_date_efektive.shpjegim: The Code's wording was changed by ligji 91/2024, date 26.7.2024. This contract was signed 08.11.2023, so it was CORRECT when signed and is outdated now. A system that judges a 2023 contract by the 2024 text produces a wrong finding. This is the case the per-article amendment tracking exists for.

klauzolat.te_sakta: 11.1 weekly rest of 36 hours including 24 uninterrupted on Sunday matches Neni 85/1 and 85/2 exactly.

klauzolat.arsyeja: 5 days paid leave for marriage or death of spouse/ascendants/descendants. Matches Neni 96/1 exactly. The 30 days unpaid for serious family illness matches Neni 132.

klauzolat.korrigjim: I originally marked this CLEAN by reading the contract and assuming it matched. I did not open Neni 130. All three models caught it. The answer key was wrong, not the models.

shkeljet.pse: Clause 13.4 pays 70% of salary during illness to employees with under 10 years of service. Neni 130/1 sets a floor of at least 80% for everyone, with no tenure split. The employer invented a distinction the Code does not make and pays below the legal minimum for most staff.
shkeljet.citim: Kur punëmarrësi nuk mund të punojë për shkak të sëmundjes, punëdhënësi i jep atij jo më pak se 80 për qind të pagës për një periudhë prej 14 ditësh të pambuluara nga sigurimet shoqërore

klauzolat.arsyeja: Social and health insurance contribution rates. Governed by ligji 7703 on social insurance, not by the Kodi i Punes. Outside this corpus.
klauzolat.shenim_vkm: Rates of 21.7% and 11.2% cannot be verified from the Code.

klauzolat.arsyeja: Health and safety obligations, correctly deferred to the Code and to ligji 10237

klauzolat.korrigjim: Second correction. I marked this clean/uncertain. Neni 122/3 prohibits employer fines outright unless set in a COLLECTIVE agreement. The models flagged it; I hedged. Found while reading an unrelated Pogradec contract.

shkeljet.pse: Clause 16.2(a) allows 'Ndalese te pages ditore' as a disciplinary sanction. Neni 122/3 forbids the employer from imposing fines except under a collective agreement, and this is an individual contract. Partly arguable: for absence (16.1.h) deducting unworked time is not a fine, but for failure to perform duties (16.1.b) it plainly is.
shkeljet.citim: Ndalohet dhënia e gjobave nga punëdhënësi, me përjashtim të gjobave të përcaktuara në kontratën kolektive.

klauzolat.arsyeja: IMPORTANT CONTROL. Clause 17.2 writes out the full sliding scale of notice periods: 2 weeks up to 6 months, 1 month from 6 months to 2 years, 2 months from 2 to 5 years, 3 months beyond. That is Neni 143/1 copied correctly. This is the clause all three models failed on in fixture 1, where it was wrong. Here it is right, so a model that flags it is producing a false positive.

te_paverifikueshme.arsyeja: normat e sigurimeve jane ne ligjin 7703, jashte korpusit
kufijte e pushimit ditor caktohen me VKM sipas Nenit 79/2

permbledhje.shenim_besueshmerie: Key v3. TWO clauses (13, 16) were corrected after models disagreed with me and turned out right. Every 'clean' verdict here is provisional.
